QB.name: Quarterback
QB.job: Takes the snap and decides: hand the ball off, throw it, or run with it. The leader of the offense.

RB.name: Running back
RB.job: Lines up behind the quarterback. Takes handoffs and runs with the ball, or catches short passes.

WR.name: Wide receiver
WR.job: Lines up wide, runs a route, and catches passes. Fast and good with their hands.

TE.name: Tight end
TE.job: Lines up next to the tackle. Half blocker, half receiver.

C.name: Center
C.job: Snaps the ball to the quarterback, then blocks. The middle of the offensive line.

G.name: Guard
G.job: Lines up next to the center and blocks for runs and passes.

T.name: Tackle
T.job: The outside blocker on the line. Protects the quarterback's blind side on passes.

DE.name: Defensive end
DE.job: Lines up on the end of the defensive line. Rushes the passer and sets the edge against runs.

DT.name: Defensive tackle
DT.job: The big player in the middle of the line. Plugs running lanes and pushes the pocket.

LB.name: Linebacker
LB.job: Lines up behind the line. Tackles runners, covers short passes, and sometimes blitzes.

CB.name: Cornerback
CB.job: Covers the wide receivers. Fast, and tries to stop catches.

S.name: Safety
S.job: The last line of defense. Lines up deep and helps against long passes and big runs.

R.name: Rusher
R.job: In flag football, the one defender allowed to chase the quarterback. Starts 7 yards back.

D.name: Defender
D.job: In flag football, covers a receiver or a zone and pulls the flag of the ball carrier.

FB.name: Fullback
FB.job: Lines up in front of the running back. A blocker first: leads the way through the hole and clears out a linebacker.

NT.name: Nose tackle
NT.job: Lines up right over the center in a 3-4 defense. The biggest player on the field, built to clog the middle.
